description_en: Queries the video playback progress after a video file is inserted into a voice call
description_zh: 在语音通话中插播视频文件后，查询视频播放进度
name: QueryVideoPlayProgress

parameters.help_en: The call ID. You can obtain the CallId from the response parameters of the SingleCallByVideo (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo) operation
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID。您可以在SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number for which to query the video playback progress
parameters.help_zh: 查询视频播放进度的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en:
The request status code.
OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码详见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Data.description_en:
The details of the returned result.

progress: the current playback duration, in milliseconds.  

duration: the total duration of the file.

The playback progress percentage can be obtained by dividing progress by duration
Data.description_zh:
返回结果详情。

progress：当前播放时长，单位毫秒  

duration：文件总时长

播放进度百分比可以通过progress除以duration获得

Message.description_en: The description of the returned result

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
